the M/L of clusters and large-scale structure depends on the cosmological parameters σ8 and Ωm in a way that is not yet understood.

the M/L ratio is an important probe of large-scale structure that can be used to constrain cosmological parameters.
the mass-to-light ratio of large-scale structures is not a reliable cosmological probe, at least not in its current incarnation.
